answer: In an agent economy Sybil resistance arises when every new identity must wander a costly spiral of progressive locked stakes that only unlock after independent review. The spiral begins with a modest deposit and tightens through successive timed contributions whose real value is measured by a prism of peer graders; each turn multiplies the capital an attacker must immobilize before gaining any voting weight. Because the path is unique and recorded on-chain, parallel fake accounts cannot share the journey without paying the full escalating cost at every step.
